d: We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and commercially driven Cross Border Business Manager to lead and expand cross-border business operations, develop international partnerships, and identify new opportunities across global markets.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing international business activities, developing market entry strategies, coordinating cross-border transactions, and strengthening relationships with overseas clients, suppliers, distributors, and strategic partners.

This role requires strong international business knowledge, commercial expertise, market intelligence capabilities, and an understanding of cross-border trade, regulatory requirements, and global operational processes.
Develop and execute cross-border business strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives.
Identify new international markets and evaluate opportunities for geographical business expansion.
Establish and maintain strategic relationships with international clients, suppliers, distributors, and business partners.
Lead cross-border business development initiatives to generate new revenue streams and expand market presence.
Manage international commercial activities, including negotiations, agreements, pricing, and business partnerships.
Coordinate cross-border transactions and ensure smooth execution of international business operations.
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and feasibility assessments for potential international markets.
Evaluate market entry opportunities, commercial risks, and regulatory requirements across different regions.
Collaborate with finance, legal, logistics, sales, procurement, and operations teams to streamline cross-border activities.
Monitor international trade regulations, customs requirements, tax considerations, and compliance obligations.
Identify opportunities to optimize international business processes, transaction costs, and operational efficiency.
Develop regional business plans, revenue forecasts, and market expansion strategies.
Monitor cross-border business performance, profitability, customer acquisition, and operational KPIs.
Resolve international business challenges and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely execution.
Represent the organization in international business meetings, trade exhibitions, conferences, and partnership discussions.
Prepare management reports, market assessments, and strategic recommendations for international business growth.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in International Business, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
5–8 years of relevant experience in Cross Border Business Development, International Business Management, Global Operations, or International Trade.
Proven experience managing international business relationships and cross-border commercial activities.
Strong understanding of global markets, international trade practices, and cross-border business operations.
Experience in international negotiations, partnership development, and commercial agreements.
Knowledge of international payment systems, trade documentation, and regulatory compliance.
Strong analytical, strategic planning, and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM/ERP platforms.
Ability to manage multiple international projects and business priorities.
Willingness to travel internationally when required.
Knowledge of Incoterms, customs procedures, international shipping, and export/import documentation.
Understanding of international banking, Letters of Credit (LC), and cross-border payment mechanisms.
Familiarity with international tax considerations and regulatory frameworks.
Experience in developing international distribution and strategic partnership networks.
Knowledge of market entry strategies and global business expansion frameworks.
Experience with SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, or other business management platforms.
Additional foreign language proficiency would be an advantage.
MBA or professional certification in International Business or Global Trade would be preferred.
Cross-border business revenue and profitability growth.
